messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour as of 2026-01-27. [decision; valid 2026-01-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-01-27]

- The security audit flagged long-lived authentication gateway tokens. [valid 2026-01-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-01-27]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13 during incident INC-2025-011. [valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident involving the indexer on 2025-10-24. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-16]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Tomasz was on call for Team Dune from 2025-09-04 until 2025-11-03, when Farah took over as primary. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-03]

    earlier: Farah is on call for Team Dune as of 2025-03-31. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-09-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-31]
- The indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, as agreed on 2025-11-07. [decision; valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-07]
- The notifier is not Cinder's service, so Cinder flagged the issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-09-26 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-26]
- The webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Cinder observed at standup on 2026-04-17 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-17]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- The authentication gateway went to team Boreal as of 2025-07-01, not the Cinder team; Cinder never owned it. [decision; valid 2025-07-18 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Cinder as of 2025-07-01. [decision; valid 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-18; recorded by handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-07-01; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-10 that the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-10]
